title: Inclusive Mobility
description: A practitioner-oriented handbook on inclusive and sustainable urban mobility. It brings together guidance on universal design and examples of inclusive transport services. Published through the 9.22 Green Mobility Platform, a sustainable mobility initiative supported by the China Academy of Urban Planning and Design and the Urban Planning Society of China.

title: Shared Public Space
description: Planning and design guidance connecting shared public space with walking, cycling, and more people-centred streets. Published through the 9.22 Green Mobility Platform as part of its annual handbook series, supported by the China Academy of Urban Planning and Design and the Urban Planning Society of China.

title: Intermodal Transport Data Sharing
description: An HKU-led pilot funded by Hong Kong's Innovation and Technology Fund. Data Trust 1.0 tested whether a trusted third party could bring together rail, bus and payment data to understand journeys involving different transport modes around Exchange Square. I contributed international policy comparisons and report writing.

title: Strategic Planning for Hong Kong 2030+
series: HKU MSc Urban Planning · Strategic Planning Studio
description: How can a long-term spatial plan guide decisions on the ground? Our HKU studio team reviewed Hong Kong's planning system and compared approaches in eight international cities. The report recommends closer coordination across departments and planning scales, more effective public engagement, and clearer monitoring and evaluation for Hong Kong 2030+.

title: Planning for an Age Friendly Kowloon City
series: HKU MSc Urban Planning · Community Planning Studio
role: Student team co-author · Presentation drawings & workshop poster
description: How can Kowloon City better support residents as they age? Our HKU studio team combined street-level engagement, surveys, stakeholder interviews and a November 2020 community workshop to develop an age-friendly neighbourhood plan. I contributed the final presentation drawings and designed the workshop promotional poster.
